scope: Preserve sanitized metadata-only model authentication failures and exact deployment-bound UI results using the existing controller and audit journal.
riskAnalysis: Historical generic metadata failure has no recoverable underlying cause. Do not infer a provider failure. Capture closed phase/status diagnostics without raw content, credential echoes, paid authority or retries; admit both existing task profiles in the metadata-only UI.

threatModel.assets: Dedicated OpenAI credentials, task ownership, immutable audit records and exact Preview identity.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Provider headers/body are untrusted. Only authenticated existing controller creates private diagnostic proof. Existing broker validates bound closed records. Frontend renders text only and rejects late deployment results.
threatModel.abuseCases: Credential echo in headers, forged diagnostic objects, cross-workspace receipt replay, stale same-source deployment result, expired owner authority, audit persistence failure.
threatModel.mitigations: Credential-aware header redaction before facts storage, closed fields and hashes, private WeakMap provenance, task/source/evidence/deployment binding, pre/post authority checks, immutable append-only journal, fixed GET with ten-second timeout and no retry.

rollback: Revert candidate feature code only, retain immutable failure receipts and historical records; keep paid flags disabled and exact release checks. No credential rotation, main/Production writes or old grant reuse.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Exact field and manifest validation reject extra credential keys, wrong values and malformed configuration event chains.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact source/runtime/task/owner/workspace bindings and fresh review receipts reject old approvals and substituted deployments.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing organization Redis CAS permits one claim and one operation dispatch; durable markers survive restart and lost acknowledgments.
negativePaths.cancellation: Revocation and canceled tasks cannot create model authority; physical preparation is recorded before I/O and missing destruction acknowledgment blocks continuation.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Closed attempts and revoked grants are insufficient: failed, missing or corrupt physical destruction evidence prevents new paid admission.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unknown provider acknowledgments remain unresolved; no automatic deployment or model retry is permitted. Owner status is read-only recovery.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Worker/nonowner/cross-workspace identities cannot journal, enroll, activate, impersonate reviewers or publish.
negativePaths.spending-limit: At most ten serial fresh attempts share four USD new retained exposure, also bounded by the unchanged five-USD ledger. Unknown counting charges remain pending, no provider hard-cap claim.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Incomplete configuration ACK chain cannot authorize execution. Model usage remains recorded on artifact failure; no generated-code execution or publication.

defects.rootCause: Metadata UI filtered out implementation tasks; generic failure discarded phase/status. Late result fences did not include deployment/origin. Candidate request ID diagnostic could echo credential before QA correction.
defects.detectionGap: Prior fixtures did not exercise implementation-profile selection, same-source deployment replacement, malformed provider metadata or credential-bearing request IDs.
defects.regression: Twenty-five offline actual-controller/profile/API/UI checks cover both profiles, timeout, cancellation, credential echo, HTTP/body/shape errors, revocation, storage failure, private DTO provenance and late results.
defects.historicalPrevention: Original generic failure remains unknown and unchanged; no retroactive root-cause assertion, raw response retention or paid diagnostic request.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing metadata GET controller, existing journal, API and UI only; no new credential, ledger or gateway.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No new dependency, provider account or infrastructure; existing dedicated credentials reused server-side.
proactiveReview.threats: Credential echo in headers, forged diagnostic objects, cross-workspace receipt replay, stale same-source deployment result, expired owner authority, audit persistence failure.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unknown diagnostics remain unconfirmed; audit failure cannot become success. Metadata never proves Responses compatibility, counting, pricing or paid authority.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Synthetic provider/error/header bodies, actual fixed timeout, owner revocation, failed persistence and same-source deployment races.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Work QA and Auditor found and verified fixes for credential header echo and stale runtime fence; no independently authenticated human acceptance claim.
proactiveReview.recovery: Keep current qualified2d1 Preview and all future execution/count flags false; all metadata and unused trial tasks cancelled. Preserve original evidence and ledgers.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused25 passed; exact successor requires STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL and authenticated Preview qualification before new task-bound metadata check or paid admission.
